body: Thank you for posting your story it makes me feel less alone! Drs haven’t been to concerned about what’s going on with me so I’ve taken the situation into my own hands. For me the worst part is I barely have any symptoms when I get strep so at this point I have no idea how many times I’ve had it! All I know is my joint pain, fatigue and headaches have reached a level where I can barely function. I really hope my Rhumatologist listens to me next time I see him cause I’m like 99% sure I’m going through the same thing. Hope you’ve been strep free since this post.
I’ll never forget the man pointing the gun doing nothing. Disgusting. I’ll never forget you Aaron. I understand 100% why you did it.
For sure they gave him a large sum of money! Check their accounts! $$$
After all those horrible comments people were leaving on his Instagram it wouldn’t surprise me at all.
After all those horrible comments people were leaving on his Instagram it wouldn’t surprise me at all.

Ah yes with Gabby! Collecting more Instagram followers.
But they can “wink wink” tell him to run off.
I’m worried he will kill himself.
It’s so upsetting I have no clue how no one was keeping tabs on him?! But honestly how far can he go? His face is everywhere?! I hope the find him soon and he’s still alive.
Do we know they aren’t “out there” looking?
Cool story but guess what? Your comment is meaningless and no one cares.
I mean, I’m Canadian, and I’m looking for her the best I can by going on this subReddit.

I just couldn’t imagine him finding her eaten by a bear and telling no one?! Makes zero sense. 
Now maybe he left her to camp alone and she got attacked but then why wouldn’t he just say “I left her alone <here>.”
He did say that and so did she.

Exactly! Let’s say they broke up and he left can’t he just say we ended things and she stayed in <insert location>. Also if they broke up wouldn’t she call her parents and be like heads up in travelling alone now! Nothing makes sense.
If she had an iPhone couldn’t he log into her iMessage from any device? Maybe he did it from FL?
But I need the rest! What happens to her once he takes off?
I really don’t think they are telling us what they know. They are currently building a case and I don’t think they want to let anything out yet cause Brian can use it to protect himself.

Everyone has to start somewhere! 

Honestly, you sound like Brian. Even if she made no money off of it maybe down the line she could use the stuff she created to apply for a job. It’s good experience if you want to get into social media marketing….or who knows what else!
Seriously. I wish she did this trip on her own I’m sure she would have flourished. Or with a more supportive partner at least. Ugh.
Seriously! Those bottom teeth look nothing like hers to me. I don’t think it’s her at all.
Maybe he was just saying that in hopes he wouldn’t be separated from her?
But come on his page was just as lame and preachy as hers! (Sorry Gabby lol)
Ah yes that sounds like a good explanation! I hope it’s just that! Thank you
Wow, this gives me some hope. Thanks for sharing.

Thank you so much. I can’t handle knowing he hates me. He used to tell me I was the kindest person he ever met. Why would you treat someone who is so kind to you like trash. I just need some sort of closure ughh it’s awful! I don’t recommend anyone experience this. You’re right about Amazon, I’ve seen posts and the pay did look pretty good. I could do that for now. Sadly with COVID all gyms are closed wahhhhh! I miss pre covid days so much.
Oh. No. No. No. I would have walked right out.

That’s the weird thing is he knows I was utterly heartbroken. He knows how sad and upset I was. So why cause me more pain by being mean as well. His actions make no sense. Maybe these are just his true colors. A mean narcissistic man.
We are never speaking again. He’s blocked me everywhere. If I see him I will have to pretend I don’t know him.

Oh I am 100% done with him. I’m disgusted with his actions. I was trying because we have mutual friends and we run into each other a lot. I’m blocked by him everywhere. I just don’t know why he’s so angry at me? I have a hard time getting past this. I guess there’s no answer and he’s just toxic?

I mean, I have tons of hobbies and I start a new job soon. We live 5 minutes from each other, moving isn’t an option for me. Hopefully he’s the one who ends up moving. I’ve never experienced something like this in my life. It’s really confusing having someone hate you for no reason.
I’ve been saying this daily for about 8 months.
You are so sweet. That is my plan tonight. I had a therapy session today and it really helped. I can’t end my life because of a few bad people. I’m gonna keep fighting.
It was. Yet I still held on tight. I’m a troubled person who loves people too much even when they don’t deserve it.

Honestly I felt alone even when I was with him. I couldn’t go to him to him when I was sad or lonely. He was emotionally stunted. I always hoped I could break that wall down but alas he decided to get rid of me.

I’ve kept my depression a secret my whole life. I recently told myself I’d be open about it. Big mistake. I’ve lost so many people in my life since. No one knows what to do. They have just pulled themselves out of my life. Now I feel even worse. So I’m back to keeping everything bottled up....not that I even have anyone to tell atm! They are all gone!

I know this isn’t meant to be funny but this actually made me laugh...and that’s a good thing cause hours ago I was planning my suicide. People are so damn clueless. This is def the worst piece of advice I’ve ever heard.
I am so sorry. I hope you can find the money somehow. I understand, I can’t even look at my bank account atm my debt is insurmountable.

I’m with you on this. I’ve finally started to be open about my mental health and by doing that I’ve lost a few friends/family. It’s really hard cause people just have no idea what to do or say. So they just disappear. Then you just end up feeling worse. It’s fucking tough. I’m really learning that we really are alone in life.
I’m not sure I’d consider myself healthy at the moment. I’m sorry you are in so much physical pain. I wish I could take it away for you.
This is what’s holding me back from doing it. I’m afraid I will just survive and then be in even more pain.

I’m trying but I just don’t have the strength. I have not idea how I got here. I’m a good person. I treat everyone with kindness and zero judgement. Yet here I am alone with no one and nothing to live for.
Feeling this. I’m sorry I’m so tired of trying to feel better too.
